newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy 10-yr Btp spread over Bund at new record low.
newsitem.headline: Italy 10-yr Btp spread over Bund at new record low.

text.p: The yield spread of the Italian February 2007 fixed rate government bond (BTP) fell to a new record of 116 basis points over the July 2007 Bund.
By 1005 GMT the Feb07 BTP was trading 25 basis points up at 99.95 with a yield of 6.86 percent while the July07 Bund was down seven basis points at 102.22 and yielding 5.695 percent.
